page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6r.large is an ARM64-based virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Ampere Altra processor running at 2.8 GHz. The instance is configured with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 2.0 GB per core ratio. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates modest performance characteristics. The single-core CPU performance via stress-ng is rated as average with a score of 1824.28, while multi-core performance drops to a weak rating at 3617.67. Memory bandwidth tests show weak to poor results, with uncached read and write speeds at 26.08 GB/sec and 16.11 GB/sec respectively. Cryptographic and database operations also sit in the lower tiers, with Passmark database operations scoring 1472.79 and Redis SET operations reaching 2.83 million operations per second.

The ecs.c6r.large offers a qualitative cost-efficiency advantage for developers seeking dedicated ARM64 resources without the overhead of larger instances. However, the lack of local storage and lower memory bandwidth are notable tradeoffs. This instance is best suited for lightweight, single-threaded applications, basic web serving, ARM64 software compilation, and minor background tasks rather than memory-intensive or high-throughput database workloads.
